title: GPIO 点灯：算出限流电阻
summary: 面包板上有人把 LED 直接接在 GPIO 上，引脚烧了。算出让 LED 电流约 10 mA 的电阻，换上去，再测引脚电压降了多少。
concepts: 引脚输出电阻 pin output resistance
引脚电流上限 pin current limit
description: 起始电路：GPIO4 设成输出高，一根黄色跳线直接接红色 LED，没有电阻。引脚输出高可以看成 3.3 V 串 25 Ω，红色 LED 是 1.8 V 串 12 Ω。用 KVL 算出 10 mA 需要的电阻，取标准值，替换那根跳线。

en.title: An LED on a GPIO: work out the resistor
en.summary: Someone wired an LED straight to a GPIO and the pin burned. Work out the resistor for about 10 mA, fit it, then measure how far the pin voltage sags.
en.description: Starting board: GPIO4 set to output high, a yellow jumper straight to a red LED, no resistor. A pin at output high is 3.3 V behind 25 Ω; a red LED is 1.8 V plus 12 Ω. Use KVL to find the resistor for 10 mA, pick a standard value and put it in place of the jumper.
compare: - No resistor: I = 1.5 / 37 ≈ **40 mA**, pin voltage ≈ 2.29 V — below VIH (2.475 V), and at the absolute maximum.
- Reading outside 8.5–11.5 mA? Check the resistor value first, then the LED's direction and that the resistor sits exactly where the jumper was.

measurements.ask: Output HIGH: ammeter in series between the resistor and the LED, read the LED current
Output HIGH: multimeter on the GPIO pin to GND
measurements.explain: 3.3 − 25 Ω × 9.5 mA ≈ 3.06 V: with current flowing out the pin is no longer 3.3 V.

measurements.ask: From your two readings, the pin's output resistance R_out = (3.3 V − V_pin) / I
measurements.explain: ≈ 25 Ω (the model value; in a real chip it is the output MOSFET's on-resistance). A pin is not an ideal voltage source: the more current, the bigger the drop.

measurements.ask: With your R_out, estimate: with no resistor, as on the starting board, the current would be
measurements.explain: I = 1.5 / (25 + 12) ≈ 40 mA and the pin sits at ≈ 2.29 V < 2.475 V (VIH). Only tiny internal resistances limit the current, so a series resistor is a must.
choices: about 40 mA, the absolute maximum, and the pin falls below VIH, not even a valid HIGH
about 10 mA, the LED limits itself
about 1.5 A, the LED burns out at once

hints: Work out the resistor first: KVL around the loop gives 3.3 V = I·(R + 25 Ω + 12 Ω) + 1.8 V; put in I = 10 mA, solve for R and take the nearest standard value.
Pull out the yellow jumper and put the resistor between the same two holes (the GPIO column and the LED's long-lead column).
tests: Output HIGH: LED on, current within 8.5–11.5 mA, the pin voltage is a valid HIGH
Output LOW: LED off, no pin current

cards.title: Watch it burn first
text: The board is already built: **GPIO4** is set to OUT HIGH, and a **yellow jumper** goes straight to a red LED, with no resistor.
Look at the **diagnostics** on the right: what happened to GPIO4?
Then **click the board** and read GPIO4's row in the pin list. Is that voltage still a valid "high"?

cards.title: A pin is not an ideal source
text: - A pin at output high is like a **3.3 V battery behind 25 Ω**. With no resistor outside, only those 25 Ω and the LED's own 12 Ω limit the current — far too little, so the current hits the limit.
- The more current, the more voltage those 25 Ω take, and the lower the pin voltage. Low enough, and another chip no longer sees it as "high":
![](fig:sag)
- The fix: a series resistor. Write KVL around the loop and solve for it:
- For 10 mA: $R = \frac{3.3 - 1.8}{0.01} - 25 - 12 = 113$ Ω; take the nearest standard value, **120 Ω** (100 Ω works too).
![](fig:loop)

cards.title: Fit the resistor
text: - **Pull out the yellow jumper** and put the resistor you worked out between the same two holes.
- LED long lead toward the resistor, short lead to GND — both are already in place.
- Press **Check my circuit**. The check switches the pin to output high and output low by itself; you can switch it in the pin list too.
- Then put an ammeter in series to read the LED current, and measure the pin voltage with the multimeter.

cards.title: Take away
text: - **An LED on a GPIO always needs a resistor**: $R = (3.3 - V_f)/I - 25 - 12$ — don't forget the pin's own 25 Ω.
- **Keep each pin ≤ 20 mA; 40 mA breaks it.** All the pins also share one budget: ten LEDs at 20 mA is 200 mA. Bigger loads need a transistor (5.3).
- Modern bright LEDs glow well at 1–2 mA; indicator lights usually get about 1 kΩ, which saves power and is easy on the eyes.

- A real-circuit catch: blue / white LEDs have $V_f$ ≈ 2.9–3.2 V, leaving almost nothing for the resistor on a 3.3 V pin, so their brightness is unstable. And keep away from the boot pins GPIO0, 2, 5, 12 and 15.

tests.name: 输出高电平：LED 亮，电流在 8.5–11.5 mA 之间，引脚电压是有效的高电平
输出低电平：LED 灭，引脚电流为 0

compare: - 没有电阻：I = 1.5 / 37 ≈ **40 mA**，引脚电压 ≈ 2.29 V，已经低于 VIH（2.475 V），还到了绝对最大值。
- 读数不在 8.5–11.5 mA 里时，先核对电阻值，再看 LED 方向和电阻是不是正好替换了那根跳线。

measurements.ask: 输出高电平：电流表串在电阻和 LED 之间，读 LED 电流
输出高电平：万用表测 GPIO 引脚对 GND 的电压
measurements.explain: 3.3 − 25 Ω × 9.5 mA ≈ 3.06 V：有电流流出时引脚不再是 3.3 V。

measurements.ask: 用你的两个读数算引脚的输出电阻 R_out = (3.3 V − V_pin) / I
measurements.explain: ≈ 25 Ω（模型值；真实芯片里是输出 MOS 管的导通电阻）。引脚不是理想电压源：电流越大，压降越大。

choices: 约 40 mA，到了绝对最大值，引脚电压低于 VIH，连“高电平”都算不上
约 10 mA，LED 自己会限流
measurements.ask: 用你算出的 R_out 估计：如果像起始电路那样不接电阻，电流会是多少？
measurements.explain: I = 1.5 / (25 + 12) ≈ 40 mA，引脚电压 ≈ 2.29 V < 2.475 V（VIH）。LED 和引脚都只靠很小的内部电阻限流，必须串电阻。

hints: 先算电阻：沿回路 KVL，3.3 V = I·(R + 25 Ω + 12 Ω) + 1.8 V，代入 I = 10 mA 解出 R，再取最接近的常用值。
拔掉黄色跳线，在同样的两个孔（GPIO 那一列和 LED 长脚那一列）之间插电阻。

cards.title: 先看它烧掉
text: 面包板上已经搭好了：**GPIO4** 设成「输出 高」，一根**黄色跳线**直接接到红色 LED，中间没有电阻。
看右边的**诊断**：GPIO4 怎么了？
再**单击开发板**，看引脚列表里 GPIO4 那一行的电压。它还算得上“高电平”吗？

cards.title: 引脚不是理想电源
text: - 输出高的引脚像一节 **3.3 V 电池串一个 25 Ω** 的小电阻。没有外接电阻时，只有这 25 Ω 和 LED 里的 12 Ω 在限流——太小了，电流冲到上限。
- 电流越大，25 Ω 上掉的电压越多，引脚电压就越低。掉到一定程度，别的芯片连“高电平”都认不出来：
![](fig:sag)
- 解决办法：串一个电阻。沿着回路写 KVL，解出电阻：
![](fig:loop)

cards.title: 换上电阻
text: - **拔掉黄色跳线**，在同样的两个孔之间插上你算出的电阻。
- LED 长脚朝电阻，短脚接 GND——这两只脚已经插好了。
- 点**「检查我的电路」**。检查会自动把引脚切换成输出高和输出低；你也可以在引脚列表里自己切换。
- 然后串一块电流表读 LED 电流，用万用表测引脚电压。

cards.title: 带走
text: - **GPIO 点 LED 一定要串电阻**：$R = (3.3 - V_f)/I - 25 - 12$，别忘了引脚自己的 25 Ω。
- **每个引脚建议 ≤ 20 mA，40 mA 就坏。** 所有引脚的电流还共用一个总预算：同时点十颗 20 mA 的灯就是 200 mA。大一点的负载要用三极管（5.3）。
- 现在的高亮 LED 1–2 mA 就很亮，指示灯常用 1 kΩ 左右，省电也不刺眼。
- 真实电路里的坑：蓝 / 白 LED 的 $V_f$ 约 2.9–3.2 V，3.3 V 引脚几乎没给电阻留下电压，亮度很不稳定。选引脚时也避开启动配置脚 GPIO0、2、5、12、15。

caption.text: 引脚电压 = 3.3 V − 25 Ω × 电流。电流越大越低；不接电阻时它会掉到虚线（VIH）以下。

i18n.en: Pin voltage = 3.3 V − 25 Ω × current. It falls as the current grows; with no resistor it drops below the dashed line (VIH).

caption.text: 3.3 V 要分给三处：25 Ω、R1 和 LED。R1 吃掉的越多，电流越小。

i18n.en: The 3.3 V is shared three ways: 25 Ω, R1 and the LED. The more R1 takes, the smaller the current.
